content.short: Moar Market is an innovative modular lending protocol on Aptos featuring isolated pools, composable leverage, and high capital efficiency.
content.description: Moar Market is an innovative, non-custodial decentralized lending protocol built natively on the Aptos blockchain. Designed for maximum capital efficiency, the platform utilizes a modular architecture that features isolated lending pools, allowing for precise risk management and specialized rates for niche assets. Users can leverage "Credit Accounts"—user-owned smart accounts that enable composable leverage by allowing borrowed funds to be deployed directly into other whitelisted Aptos DeFi protocols while remaining within the secure account framework. By leveraging the high throughput of Move, Moar Market delivers a professional-grade borrowing experience.
